compiler: We need to improve code generation and optimization passes in our JIT compiler to better handle data locality, tensor operations, and distributed computing while maintaining compiler extensibility.
graph: We need to improve training efficiency and scalability for large graphs through better sampling strategies, memory management, and distributed processing.
storage: We need to optimize the performance tradeoffs between write amplification, read amplification, and space amplification in our LSM-tree design, and improve compaction efficiency for diverse workloads.
thin-gnn: We need to improve training efficiency and scalability for large graph neural networks on distributed systems with better sampling and communication strategies.
thin-kv: We need to improve transaction commit latency and throughput in our distributed key-value store, especially across geographically dispersed replicas.
thin-lang: We need to improve function call overhead and code generation efficiency while supporting incremental type checking in our compiler.
